notes.title: Update #3 - Late Game Gameplay and Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/2b6dba876a9330084aa2b25b2007d37a68551e67.png
Late Game Gameplay and Balance Adjustments

 Monster Scaling Rework
Heroic Bosses and Mini-bosses now have a steeper HP scaling curve in the late game.
All enemies now have a slightly gentler damage scaling curve in the late game.
 Traveler Scaling Rework
Reduced base stats for all Travelers while increasing their growth stats based on their characteristics.
Melee Travelers now receive increased HP scaling and base defense.
 Mirage Skin Rework
Mirage Skin debuff's healing reduction effect has been changed from 100% -> 90%.
Melee Travelers now receive this debuff progressively at 30% -> 60% -> 90% with each hit.
 Added the ability to rename public lobbies
 Memory and Essence chat pings now show related information when hovering over them.

Hello Travelers, Happy New Year!
Today, we've implemented our third irregular update focusing on balance and late-game experience improvements!

We're trying various solutions to address the late-game balance issues you've reported, and we've implemented some of them in this update. We'd appreciate your feedback about these changes on Discord and Steam!

Prologue is Ending Soon!
The prologue period will end before the Steam Next Fest scheduled for late February, and all content will be transferred from the prologue to the demo. We're also excited to announce that the February Steam Next Fest demo will include new content updates.

Don't worry - all your prologue save data will be transferred to the demo!

Balance Changes

 Slightly increased Vesper's base HP
 Slightly reduced HP increase and healing amount of Vesper's first passive Memory
 Increased healing amount of Vesper's second passive Memory
 Slightly increased invulnerability duration of Winter Fall Memory, enemies now ignore players casting Winter Fall
 Reduced damage upgrade scaling of Mist's Deflect Memory
 Buffed damage of Talc Essence, Sharpness Essence, and Desolation Essence
 Changed Blade Essence to scale with AD
 Changed Celestial Essence cooldown from 5 -> 10 seconds, projectiles from 3 -> 4, and increased damage
 Changed Aurena's passive Memory scaling from AP -> AD
 Changed Arrow Rain Memory trigger condition from Basic Attack -> Attack

Other Changes

 Travelers affected by Dark Impulse curse can now be attacked by allies
 Frost Essence and Blade Essence now affected by Flow Essence's cooldown reduction
 Game preparation screen now remembers previously selected Lucid Dream
 Improved various overly intense lighting effects
 Reduced Hunter Ambush Orb health
 Significantly reduced initial loading time and VRAM usage

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where resources would disappear when shared while dead
 Fixed a bug where some mini-bosses spawned Unstoppable despite active Lucid Dream
 Fixed a bug where Dream Dust increase upgrade wasn't applying when dismantling Memories
 Improved memory-related crashes
 Fixed a bug where using movement abilities before boss fights would prevent entry and freeze the game
 Fixed a bug showing unnecessary arrows in Obliviax map
 Fixed Mist's dodge ability upgrade not showing in tooltip
 Fixed Pure Essence triggering on self
 Fixed water sound volume not following settings in certain areas
 Fixed damage numbers showing squares in some languages
 Improved grammar in some language texts

notes.title: Update #2 - Hunter of Oblivion, New Ultimate Memory
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274936/a96a4e33d0bf3d96316ce2de50a062b4e7633dd6.png
Hunter of Oblivion, New Ultimate Memory

 New Secret Boss, Hunter of Oblivion - She will appear when your party visits the Hunter's territory multiple times.
 Unlockable Legendary Ultimate Memory - Shout of Oblivion
For the first time ever, an obtainable ultimate Memory has been added! Share your thoughts and ideas on Discord and Steam!
 Added Gold and Dream Dust sharing in co-op
 Added player kick function
 You can now check chat history

Hello Travelers, are you having a warm holiday season?
The wait is over - our second interim update is now live!

This new secret boss is designed for veteran Travelers who no longer feel threatened by the Hunters. Only the well-prepared will be able to defeat her.

Additionally, we've implemented several features based on your feedback from Discord and Steam. We're also keeping track of suggestions that haven't been implemented yet. We'll do our best to incorporate necessary changes into the game. Thank you for helping us make a better game!

Furthermore, in our next update planned for mid-January, we'll be implementing experimental patches to improve late-game balance. Please share your thoughts about late-game gameplay on Discord and Steam! We'll carefully consider all the feedback you've provided for this upcoming update.

Thank you for your support throughout the year. Happy holidays!

Other Changes

 Increased Curse gold/Dream Dust rewards in late game
 Increased required monster kills for Curses in late game
 Fixed intermittent leveling bug
 Mouse wheel controls can now be configured
 Curse Sanctuary rewards now display in chat
 Fixed FPS limit settings not applying
 Added option to hide ally damage numbers
 Improved gamepad controls for checking ally items
 Enhanced gamepad controls in title and results screens
 Added damage number abbreviation feature
 Fixed bonus Dream Dust text sometimes not showing in co-op
 Fixed control settings reset not working

notes.title: Update #1 - QoL Features Added, Numerous Bug Fixes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274936/02596f59decc70bc4a01cfd10e4601fa8827c36f.png
QoL Features Added, Numerous Bug Fixes

 Added mouse sensitivity and cursor color settings
 Fixed a bug where leveling up would stop in late game
 Increased Reverie reroll count from 2 to 3
 Ambush events now reward Chaos
 Eye of the Sun Essence damage increased by 20%

Greetings Travelers,
An interim update focused on bug fixes and quality of life improvements has been deployed!

Many bugs reported by you on Discord and Steam have been fixed, and we're working hard to address the remaining bugs and implement your feedback that weren't included in this patch. Thank you for helping us make the game better!

ps. The next content update is scheduled for late December!

Other Changes

 Added automatic recovery system for corrupted save files
 Slightly reduced teammate revival distance in Nightmare difficulty
 Improved performance in Ice Lake
 Reduced screen shake from Thunder Essence
 Fixed unfair fire damage taken by Travelers in late game
 Fixed an issue where dropping items before boss fights in co-op would break game progression
 Improved event translations

Bug Fixes

 [strike]Fixed a bug where gold gained from Essence of Wealth was being shared in co-op[/strike]
Rolled back the changes to keep gold sharing, and added tooltip explanation to remove ambiguity.
 [strike]Fixed a bug where Mist could deflect undodgeable damage[/strike]
While HP sacrifice shrine damage remains undeflectable, we've added a special exception allowing Essence of Overload to be deflected when deflection is upgraded.
 Fixed a bug where "Harmless Whispers" Lucid Dream wasn't applying to mini-bosses
 Fixed Lacerta's basic attack range constantly changing
 Fixed a bug where using Mist's second Q skill to dash would position you inside monsters and get hit
 Fixed an intermittent bug where skill cast mode would get stuck on normal casting
 Fixed teammate soul placement not considering exit boss position
 Fixed Vesper not receiving passive healing when killing monsters with critical hits
 Fixed a bug where players sometimes couldn't pass through barriers in co-op boss fights
 Fixed instances where players could get trapped in Radiant Rift rooms
 Fixed incorrect interaction between Yubar's second R skill and Flow Essence
 Fixed large bosses occasionally dying suddenly
 Fixed occasional blue or white screen flashes that made the game unplayable
 Fixed inability to interact with shops when Memory cast was bound to mouse buttons (especially left click)

Some changes have been rolled back. We apologize for any missing notes in the patch notes and thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Week #2 - Lucid Dream and Reverie
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274936/722bc15a0d1cd3847cf85015bc3c1bf43193155c.jpg
Lucid Dream and Reverie

Week #2 Patch Notes

 Lucid Dream - Change the rules of The Rapids and play the game as you wish.
 1 Unlockable Lucid Dream - Make bosses affected by crowd control.
 Reverie - Obtain more upgrade materials through daily quests.
 New Unlockable Memory - Malicious Touch
 New Memories - Lightning Strike, Retreat
 New Unlockable Essence - Finality
 New Essence - Rigidity
 Added Reset Upgrade Tree feature
 Fixed a bug where Aurena's Q skill healing bonus was not working
 Reduced duration of Mirage Skin's healing reduction
 Respawn location is now closer on Easy and Normal difficulties.


Hello Travelers, thank you for your patience!

The Week 2 update has been applied today!

Along with the Lucid Dream system that allows you to freely change the rules of The Rapids, 1 unlockable Lucid Dream has been added to the game. Frustrated that stun and knockback skills were useless in boss fights? Try playing the game with the new Lucid Dream activated and share your thoughts. Based on user feedback, this Lucid Dream may be incorporated into the base rules of the game!

Many gameplay suggestions have been implemented along with fixes for bugs reported by you all. In particular, to address the lack of upgrade materials, we experimentally added the Reverie system. Let us know what you think about the current system and other changes. We will continue to actively accept feedback from Travelers!

✨ Share your opinions with other players on Discord and get quick answers to your questions!

notes.content:

The Prologue has begun!

Week #1 Patch Notes

 New unlockable character, Aurena - A battle healer who sacrifices her own health
 Endless Mode - You can now choose to repeat the game at the final level
 New unlockable Memory - Mind Corruption
 New Memory - Black Thunderbolt
 Unlockable Essences - Holy Faith, Flexibility, Vengeance
 All upgrade trees unlocked
 Various content reworks and secret elements
 Visual reworks for Forest, Snowy Mountain, and characters
 New soundtrack
 New multiplayer servers for improved connectivity and stability - We need your feedback!


Greetings, Travelers!

The Prologue Beta Test starting today will run for a limited time, testing experimental features and content before they are applied to the main game. During the first 4 weeks of the Prologue, new content will be added every week.

Please participate in the beta test and actively share your opinions on the difficulty, balance, new content, and more!

✨ Join our Discord to discuss with other players and get quick answers to your questions!

Regarding Save Files
Your progress from the demo version will carry over to the Prologue. Even after the Prologue period ends, you can continue your save file in the demo and the full version when it releases. Don't worry and join the Prologue!
